title: Vatican historical imagery leads
purpose: Research leads only. None of these records should be treated as a georeferenced raster overlay until the original image, footprint, and metadata are verified.

workflow: Identify actual frame footprints intersecting the target extent.
Download the original image and metadata under the archive's access and licensing rules.
Record acquisition date separately from publication, catalog, or postmark date.
Georeference using documented control points and record CRS, transformation method, and residual error.
Publish each validated raster as a separate date-stamped layer with source provenance.
